rationale: The downtrend thesis remains intact as the instrument consolidates near the session low of $14.92, well below both the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.11) and session VWAP ($15.55). Broad market weakness continues with SPY down 2.03% and VIXY up 5.55%, and recent 1-minute bounce attempts have failed on low volume below $15.06. Maintaining the position allows price to test and break the $14.94 support level toward the $14.90 take-profit target.
